description: Button option/prop naming for @spectrum-web-components/button, verified against gen2/packages/swc/components/button/Button.ts and gen2/packages/core/components/button/Button.types.ts.

componentOptions.notes: Lit JS property is fillStyle (camelCase); its reflected HTML attribute is fill-style.
Values match canonical casing (s|m|l|xl); no per-value aliasing needed on this platform.
SWC also exposes a pending-label attribute (accessible-name override during pending) with no canonical counterpart; not modeled here since it's not a value of an existing option.

No direct prop equivalent found on this platform. Icon-only rendering is inferred from slot presence (no default-slot content) rather than an explicit boolean toggle. Left without a platformProp intentionally — a generator should skip this option for Web Components rather than guess an attribute name.
